about: A code's challenge changes (its "c"), and what a code may keep of them with the right types (#108, #302): kept is what CodeFormat.FilterChallenge keeps, dropped the paths it leaves out, in order. Against the game's default challenge (web/src/data/game.json), or the case's own defaults. Read by web/test/decode-details.test.ts and UnitTests/ChallengeFilterTests.cs.
